answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims to generate concise and informative texts from input documents... Extensive experimental results on CNN/DM, WikiHow, and NYT50 datasets, have shown that SARA effectively improves the quality and faithfulness of summaries generated by various LLMs (e.g., GPT-Neo, LLaMA, OPT) without requiring any modifications to the LLM weights.

answer_2.quote: Metrics. Following prior works, ROUGE, BERTScore-Prediction, and FactKB are used to measure the quality and factual consistency, respectively. In addition, SacreBLEU is also introduced to evaluate the summaries. Furthermore, we utilize GPT-4 to evaluate the quality and faithfulness of the generated summaries...

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT-4 to evaluate the quality and faithfulness of the generated summaries. GPT-4 ranks the summaries generated by different methods based on the original documents and reference summaries.
methods: ranking summaries based on quality and faithfulness (pairwise/joint ranking)
